zh: Agent 执行需要输入的命令（如 CLI 登录粘贴凭据、确认提示）时，会在右侧终端面板打开交互标签，直接在终端里输入即可，输入内容不会发给模型。
终端面板中的网址可直接点击打开，支持 ⌘C / 右键 / 复制按钮复制选中内容或全部输出。
修复 Agent 调用工具后回复下方 TPS 与 TTFT 显示为空的问题。
en: When an agent command needs input (CLI login credentials, confirmations), an interactive tab opens in the terminal panel so you can type there; your input is hidden from the model.
Links in the terminal panel are clickable, and you can copy the selection or all output with ⌘C, right click or the copy button.
Fixed TPS and TTFT showing as empty under agent replies that used tools.
